description: Henley: visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to 40 countries, ranked 90th. Other indices: 95th with 45 destinations, 86th with a mobility score of 51, and 190th of 199 on one measure. No visa-free access to the Schengen area at all.
energy_note: Forty countries. The rest require permission you will not get.

aspect: Refusal rates, and what applying costs
description: US State Department data for FY2024 gave an adjusted B-1/B-2 refusal rate of 55.54% for Iranian nationals. Each attempt costs a fee, a journey to a third country to find an embassy, hotels, and time off work - all non-refundable on refusal.
energy_note: A coin flip you pay four figures to call.

description: Proclamation 10998 bans issuance of all immigrant and nonimmigrant visa categories for Iranian nationals from 1 January 2026, with no expiry and 180-day reviews. F-1 students are included this time, unlike 2017. USCIS has placed an indefinite adjudication hold on virtually all pending benefits for Iranian nationals.
energy_note: Not a hard queue. A closed door with no number on it.

aspect: Barred outright from entry to specific states
description: Iranian passport holders are barred from entering Libya, Syria, the UAE and the United States - the UAE being the regional hub that most Iranian business and family travel routes through.
energy_note: The hub your whole region routes through, closed.

aspect: Airspace closure removes even the countries that would have you
description: In January 2026 Iran issued a NOTAM closing airspace to all flights without prior permission; flight tracking showed aircraft denied entry or rerouted. The 2026 war closed airspace across multiple countries and stranded hundreds of thousands.
energy_note: The forty countries are also unreachable this week.

aspect: The psychological shape of it: a life with a ceiling
description: Conferences not attended, jobs not applied for, a sibling's wedding not reached, a parent's funeral missed. The effect is not a single blocked trip but a lifetime of pre-emptive self-exclusion from anything requiring a border.
energy_note: Not applying, because why would you.
